title: CeraVe named ‘official moisturiser of Arrakis’ with Dune Part Three film tie-up
summary: In its first film partnership, CeraVe’s Dune Part Three activations will roll out globally ahead of the film’s release in December

extraction.key_fact: 세라비가 영화 듄 파트 3와 첫 영화 협업을 맺고 글로벌 마케팅을 진행한다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: In its first film partnership, CeraVe’s Dune Part Three activations will roll out globally ahead of the film’s release in December
